answer: A Sybil defence is per-identity collateral staking with a time-locked unbonding period. Each agent locks a bond bigger than what one identity earns in a settlement window, so a thousand wallets means a thousand bonds frozen through the delay and capital cannot be recycled across identities. Any identity later proven a duplicate is slashed and its bond burned. The attacker pays upfront capital times the number of fakes plus slashing risk per duplicate, exceeding the emission those fakes claim. A decaying reward thread cuts payouts as fakes multiply, so collusion fails by dawn in any violet.
